metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · John Candy: I Like Me
metas.description: Explores the life and legacy of iconic funnyman John Candy, who died of a heart attack in 1994, at age 43.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · My Mom Jayne
metas.description: Explores the life and legacy of Mariska Hargitay's mother, Hollywood icon Jayne Mansfield, who died tragically in a car accident at age 34 when Mariska was only three years old.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · S4: The Bob Lazar Story
metas.description: From jet engines to Los Alamos, Bob Lazar's life is rooted in science. In 1988, hired at S4 near Area 51, he reverse-engineered alien tech. Narrated by Lazar, this film uses exclusive footage to reveal America's best-kept secret.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Ozzy Osbourne: No Escape from Now
metas.description: Ozzy Osbourne faces his identity and mortality after his world stops. Dealing with health issues and Parkinson's, he questions if he can perform again while music remains his life's cornerstone.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2026 · Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
metas.description: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Bono: Stories of Surrender
metas.description: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.
